meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 Python 脚本来处理 PDF 文件，包括提取文本、表格、填写表单、合并拆分 PDF，并带有错误处理和验证。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 PDF 文件（如提取表格、填写表单、合并 PDF）时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个PDF里的所有表格，保存为CSV。
用这个JSON数据填写PDF表单，并验证结果。
把这三个PDF合并成一个文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run Python scripts to process PDF files, including extracting text and tables, filling forms, merging and splitting PDFs, with error handling and validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests PDF processing tasks such as extracting tables, filling forms, or merging PDFs.

say_en.text: Extract all tables from this PDF and save as CSV.
Fill the PDF form with this JSON data and validate.
Merge these three PDFs into one file.
